node: Advanced nuclear components, reactor services, TRISO or advanced fuel fabrication, and naval/defense nuclear supply
summary: Layer 1B expands the investable universe around qualified nuclear manufacturing and fuel-cycle bottlenecks rather than speculative reactor developers. The cleanest reference exposure remains BWX Technologies, with direct naval nuclear, reactor, component, and advanced fuel exposure. The underfollowed lane adds Centrus Energy for HALEU enrichment, Curtiss-Wright for naval/commercial nuclear pumps, valves, and reactor-coolant equipment, and Graham Corp. as a small-cap speculative supplier of mission-critical fluid, heat-transfer, and propulsion hardware touching naval nuclear and SMR/nuclear thermal propulsion programs. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
